blocks.content: I started to make a new game :o. It will be Spooky game im planing to release it in early 2027 like january. It will be topdown horror game with a fun mechanic like fnaf. So you can be REALly suck at game or you can grind like Esport player. I bet there will be speedruners :D. Game will be located in anantha town well this place is special for us its our first game idea ever, in 2025 My frends and i decided to make a retro 3d game but things didnt work well so end of the day What I got is bunch of ideas and larping. So I was thinkg about making a fun game but also Spooky and complex story so i ended up in making a game staged in a highschool called anatha academy. Thats all for today i will make more entrys in future.
